# 0052. Collapsed cards: lockfiles, large diffs and generated files

- Status: Accepted
- Date: 2026-10-30

## Context

Some files in a review are rarely read line by line and expensive to render: lockfiles (a 1 600-package `package-lock.json` bump is about 10 000 rows and 130 000 DOM nodes), very large patches, and generated code. On the profiled 305-file review the lockfile alone took `j`/`k` from 63 to 488 ms and frames from 17 to 183 ms (ADR 0050). GitHub collapses such files: `linguist-generated` in `.gitattributes` marks generated files, `-diff` suppresses a diff, and large diffs show "Load diff". Reviewers expect the same here, and ADR 0051 chose collapsing over virtualizing giant cards.

## Decision

- **What starts collapsed** (`plan-diff-deferrals.ts`, pure, in order): `-diff` in `.gitattributes`; `linguist-generated` (set, or any value but `false`); lockfiles by name (`package-lock.json`, `npm-shrinkwrap.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `yarn.lock`, `bun.lock`, `deno.lock`, `Cargo.lock`, `go.sum`, `go.work.sum`, `poetry.lock`, `Pipfile.lock`, `uv.lock`, `pdm.lock`, `Gemfile.lock`, `composer.lock`, `mix.lock`, `pubspec.lock`, `Podfile.lock`, `Package.resolved`, `packages.lock.json`, `gradle.lockfile`, `flake.lock`, `renv.lock`); a few of Linguist's name patterns for generated code (`*.min.js`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`/`.css`, their `.map` source maps, `*.pb.go`/`.pb.cc`/`.pb.h`, `*_pb2.py`/`_pb2_grpc.py`/`.pyi`, `__generated__/`); and any patch over 3 000 lines or 256 KiB of text. `.gitattributes` is authoritative: `linguist-generated=false` or `-linguist-generated` overrides the lockfile and name rules, though not the size limit. We left out Linguist's `dist/` and other vendored-path rules: they mean "vendored", not "generated", and tracked `dist/` folders are often meant to be reviewed. Files without hunks (binary, pure renames) never collapse.
- **Attributes come from the head.** `readDiffAttributes` (git domain) runs one `git check-attr --source=<head> -z --stdin linguist-generated diff` over the review's paths, so neither the working tree nor the index matters, and `parseCheckAttr` reads the NUL-separated triples. `--source` needs git 2.40; older gits get empty lists and only beuve's own rules apply. Main serves it as `session:get-file-attributes { sessionId }` → `{ headSha, generated, notGenerated, noDiff }` (head paths, base path for a deleted file), cached per head and paths in `src/main/files/`. The renderer asks once per review, beside `session:get-tree`.
- **A collapsed card** keeps its header (status, path, +/−, the ImpactGate chip) with a quiet tag (`lockfile`, `generated`, `diff off`, `large`) and shows one line instead of the diff: why, its size (lines and KB), "Load diff", and `Space`. The diff is never mounted until loaded. Generated and `-diff` cards are dimmed while collapsed. Space on the active card loads a collapsed card or collapses an open one (the spec's "expand/collapse", now in the command registry). `j`/`k` treat a collapsed card as one stop at its header, so they never walk through an unloaded body. Every jump into a card's lines (citations, the dock, the palette, insights, `m`, `e`, find) loads it first. Loaded and collapsed choices last for the session.
- **Totals and the tree.** Collapsed files still count in the review's file and +/− totals, ImpactGate, the dock and "Mark reviewed". In the radar tree a generated file takes the library's dimmed `ignored` lane instead of its change status and stays selectable.
- **Showing generated files.** `/generated show|hide` in the chat (bare `/generated` says which), and "Show / collapse generated files" in the palette, toggle whether generated-only cards (generated or `-diff`, not also over the size limit) start expanded. Main keeps it as `showGenerated` in `settings.json` through `display:get`/`display:set` (ADR 0042), default collapsed.

## Consequences

Lockfile bumps and generated churn no longer slow the stream or `j`/`k`, and the reviewer sees at a glance which files they are and how big. Teams steer it with the same `.gitattributes` lines GitHub reads. A reviewer who needs a collapsed file presses Space or follows any link into it. The thresholds are guesses tuned on synthetic repositories; files between about 1 500 and 3 000 lines still render whole and are slower on first mount. Name rules may misfire on a hand-written `*.min.js`; `linguist-generated=false` fixes that per repository.
